papers.title: OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining
papers.desc: World-Action Models inherit world knowledge from video-generative priors, and channel it into executable control signals through embodied experience.

papers.title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.desc: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others.

papers.title: Measuring Language Transfer in Robot Policies: Adding Greek to a Cosmos3 Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.desc: Robot foundation models are trained and evaluated predominantly in English, and robot demonstration corpora do not exist for most languages.

papers.title: What Did I Just Say? Self-Listening for Full-Duplex Speech Models
papers.desc: Full-duplex spoken language models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling them to handle interruptions and backchannels in human conversation.

papers.title: Harnessing CLIP and DINO: An Uncertainty-Aware Cascaded Fusion Network for Generalizable Deepfake Image Detection
papers.desc: The growing realism and accessibility of manipulated and generated faces threaten the trustworthiness of digital media.

papers.title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
papers.desc: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output.

papers.title: Cadence: Error-Bounded Lossy Compression of Demand Time Series with a Time-Series Foundation Model
papers.desc: We present Cadence, an error-bounded lossy compressor for numeric time series pairing a 330M-parameter time-series foundation model (Google TimesFM-3) with an adaptive arithmetic coder, guaranteeing |x_t-x_t|leτ on every sample.

papers.title: ReactVAU: A Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for Streaming Video Anomaly Understanding
papers.desc: In this paper, we propose ReactVAU, a Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for real-time streaming Video Anomaly Understanding (VAU).

papers.title: SQS: Bayesian DNN Compression through Sparse Quantized Sub-distributions
papers.desc: Compressing large-scale neural networks is essential for deploying models on resource-constrained devices.

papers.title: SynthGait-19K: A Physically Grounded Synthetic Video Dataset for Gait Parameter Estimation
papers.desc: Accurate estimation of clinically meaningful gait parameters from monocular video is important for scalable mobility assessment, yet progress is limited by the small scale, restricted viewpoints, and limited visual diversity of existing datasets.

papers.title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
papers.desc: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) but incurs substantial computation and context costs.

papers.title: RelightFormer: Feed-forward Generative Transformer for Multiview Object Relighting
papers.desc: Image relighting is traditionally tackled via complex inverse rendering pipelines, which suffer from ill-posed optimization, or single-image generative models that ignore crucial multi-view cues necessary for understanding 3D geometry and material interactions.

papers.title: MasterControl Seventeen Every Time
papers.desc: We study a governed approach to enterprise analytics: a language model interprets the question, while deterministic policy selects and runs a pre-approved analytical program that returns both results and evidence.

papers.title: Counter-Swarm Doctrine: Containing Coordinated Agent Intrusions
papers.desc: Agents can turn shared infrastructure into a channel for coordinated intrusion.

papers.title: Learning 3D Editing without Paired Supervision via Generative Prior Distillation
papers.desc: Instruction-guided 3D editing is essential for interactive content creation, yet it faces a significant bottleneck: the severe scarcity of high-quality paired training data.
